what: The held-out set for the release diff, frozen before any release in it existed. eval/releases.mjs chose the graded signals on 98 real release pairs, so its 0 of 98 is in-sample. This file fixes, in advance, which later releases count and which signals are graded, so the false-positive rate on them is measured, not chosen. Read by eval/heldout.mjs.
cutoffNote: The time main reached 7a59bb5 (release 0.6.0, which shipped the graded set). Only releases published after it count.
rule: For each package below, every stable version (no prerelease tag) whose registry publish time is after the cutoff, and that is not already in eval/data/npm-releases.json, is compared with the stable version published just before it. A pair is a false positive when the comparison has a graded signal. The digest checked is the registry's at measuring time.
